sources: recreation.gov public search API campsite catalog for facility 253918 (17 reservable sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov rates and catalog for facility 253918 (only site type STANDARD NONELECTRIC; no electric/water/sewer attributes on any of the 17 catalogued sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: recreation.gov: 46 campsites, 17 reservable in Loop A and 29 first-come in Loop B; the Forest Service page says '48 camping units'. Paved sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/253918 ('The campground has 46 campsites in total. 17 campsites can be reserved in advance and 29 campsites are available as first-come, first-served. Reservable sites are in Loop A, and Loop B is first-come, first-served'; amenity 'Paved Sites') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/piney-campground-and-picnic-area ('has 48 camping units'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking-water hand pumps, garbage service, bear-resistant food lockers. No dump station; the closest is in Anaconda.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/253918 ('The campground features drinking water pumps and vault toilets', 'No dump station on site; closest facility is in Anaconda', 'Bear resistant storage lockers are available at the campground') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/piney-campground-and-picnic-area ('ADA-accessible toilets, water, a boat launch area, fishing access, and garbage services'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service page gives two closings: Seasons of Use 'Open annually mid-May through late September, weather dependent'; Operational Hours 'Open annually mid-May through late October, weather dependent.' recreation.gov sells reservable nights 2026-05-21 to 09-13 and first-come nights 09-14 to 10-01.

$17 a night; extra vehicle $5 a day (first two vehicles free per recreation.gov); a second camping unit on a site is charged double occupancy. Cash or check only at the campground's self-serve station, or pay via the recreation.gov app's Scan and Pay where available.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/piney-campground-and-picnic-area ('Single Site: $17 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/253918 (notices) and /rates (2026 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $17), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 17 sites (Loop A) reservable on recreation.gov until 4 days before arrival; 29 (Loop B) first-come. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends for reservations. 16-day stay limit, and recreation.gov caps reservations at 32 nights a year. Reserved sites are held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/253918 (description and notices; rules minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4 days prior to arrival, maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights each year) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/piney-campground-and-picnic-area ('16-day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, Pintler Ranger District, on Georgetown Lake ~13 mi south of Philipsburg off MT-1 (Georgetown Lake Road, 2 mi past the dam). Paved roads, boat ramp and day-use picnic area; overlooks the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 46 sites (17 reservable / 29 first-come), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, $17 (2026), recreation.gov. Changed season closes 09-13 (rate-season edge) -> cleared, with the FS 'mid-May through late September/October' statements in season.note. Added no dump station, 16-night limit, holiday 3-night minimum, 4-day booking cutoff. Not stated: max rig length (45 ft derived left; catalog lengths blank), booking window (180 inherited left), senior/access discount for this campground. Note trimmed of restated values.
